svg.title: Every Codewhale TUI theme — Truecolor / Paper · page 4/6
svg.desc: Sixteen source presets with their actual backgrounds, status, permission and mode inks. Actual ratatui buffer renders: tui-theme-tokyo-night, tui-theme-dracula, tui-theme-gruvbox-dark
